Hello Efi, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I can see that there is someone charging right now at this charging station. Is it possible that the screen is working again?
Remotely I can see the screen but it's via Software, in terms of hardware it can be different.
I believe that the screen is working since the Authentication methods are RFID and PIN, which you need to select in the screen before you use it.
Please let me know your feedback.
BEst regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0444263-DC/Si-D/IL- [MP / R6 170002068] Fault in the charger CRM:00315002937
additional_info.body:
Hi Orel,
Efi sent me 2 photos with the screen black, please do the normal checks, if DP cable is properly inserted and the 24V supply to the PCB.
If nothing works, then please replace the HMI.
This charger is out of warranty so please feel free to align with the customer how you want to proceed. I believe the HMI has a warranty period, if you bought it within that period it should be covered.
I will send the ticket to RC-IL queue.
Tahnks!
Best regards,
Francisco
